newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: House of Investments 4-mth net sharply down.
newsitem.headline: House of Investments 4-mth net sharply down.

text.p: The House of Investments (HI) said its net income for the first four months of the year went down sharply to 43.4 million pesos from 81.8 million.
Equity in earnings of subsidiaries and affiliates reached 59.5 million pesos compared with 93.9 million, while interest and other income were at 9.4 million pesos against 4.8 million pesos.
Among the subsidiaries whose contributions dropped significantly was the BA Savings Bank which shrank to 5.0 million pesos from last year's 36 million pesos.
Contribution from the 51 percent owned unit EEI Corp slid to 26.4 million pesos from 31.3 million pesos.
Operating expenses reached 16.0 million pesos from 10.2 million.
The holding company was projecting a net income of 303 million pesos this year from 252 million last year.
